response: {"headline": "VICTORION-2P (17,004 patients) is forecast as robust success for inclisiran based on strong PCSK9 genetics, consistent ~40-65% LDL-C lowering, and prior PCSK9 inhibitor class success, though follow-up duration and event count remain unknown.", "summary": "The VICTORION-2P trial has randomized 17,004 participants with established cardiovascular disease (LDL-C ≥70 mg/dL) to inclisiran versus placebo with a 3P-MACE primary endpoint. The calculator cannot compute power or minimum detectable effect because follow-up duration and event count are unknown (757 events needed for 80% power). However, mechanistic evidence strongly supports success: PCSK9 has an OpenTargets genetic association score of 0.949 with coronary artery disorder; inclisiran achieves consistent 40-65% placebo-adjusted LDL-C lowering across ORION-11 (time-averaged -41%, Day 510 -43.7%), ORION-15 (-56.6% to -65.3%), and ORION-3 (4-year averaged -44.2%); prior PCSK9 monoclonal antibodies (evolocumab FOURIER, alirocumab ODYSSEY) demonstrated ~15% RRR (HR ~0.85) in similar secondary prevention populations.
